integrity: The target theorem and proof were inspected in the open-access full text. The replacement proof is an exact Hilbert-space norm argument, the failure of the printed intermediate inequality has a one-dimensional exact witness, and sharpness is attained by a one-dimensional family for every coefficient/lower-bound parameter list.
scientific_limitations: The sharpness is universal with respect to the certified lower bounds and coefficients only. A particular operator tuple may admit a larger lower bound because of cancellation or additional geometry, and the certified lower bounds need not themselves be optimal.
title: Sharp universal coefficient bound for linear combinations in \(K\)-\(g\)-fusion frames
